scope: Fixed representative synthetic setup notes plus real source function snippets. Archived distractors are deliberate. This is not live personal-memory indexing or general benchmark certification.

documents.text: Current sleep routine: begin at 21:00. Switch the ceiling lamp off immediately; gradually warm and dim the other bedroom lights until 22:30, then switch them off.
Current wake routine: start at 09:00 and smoothly increase bedroom brightness from zero to full intensity over sixty minutes, reaching 100 percent at 10:00.
The preferred primary voice is an expressive calm narrator delivered locally by Chatterbox Nano with reference C. Emotional delivery should be selected intelligently from conversational meaning.
Fallback speech uses Kokoro Onyx at the accepted faster conversational pace when the primary speech synthesizer fails. This is recovery, not the primary voice.
PersonaPlex weights are downloaded, but real-time PersonaPlex inference is deferred until a stronger workstation is available. Do not load it during current voice testing.
FreeVideo was downloaded for later experimentation. The low-memory video attempt was deferred after resource limits; unload its model and wait for a stronger PC.
Decision 2.0 evaluation is finished and integration was cancelled. Avoid spending RAM on a decision worker; reconsider future open decision models later.
SecondBrain automatic personal-life capture is disabled. Proposed memories require review with sources and support correction or deletion before any automatic capture is enabled.
SecondBrain uses organized Markdown folders for Daily, Areas, Projects, People, Preferences, Decisions and Commitments. Relevant evidence is retrieved selectively instead of loading every file.
Dream produces reviewable memory-maintenance proposals with evidence, ledger records and recovery. Automatic scheduled Dream publication and self-heal repair remain disabled.
Movie themes use a reusable dim palette researched for the current film or show, with slow staggered colour movement among bedroom bulbs, ceiling and PC RGB when included.
Cinematic lighting includes the ceiling and combines dim warm white with orange and amber, like a soft cinema atmosphere.
The intimate lighting mode includes ceiling light, red and shades of purple, with calm staggered transitions on a one-minute colour cycle.
Thermal warning policy: amber when CPU reaches 85 Celsius or GPU reaches 80; red when CPU reaches 95 or GPU reaches 85. Send phone alerts and restore the prior mood after cooling.
Home Assistant OS runs locally in VirtualBox with 2048 MiB memory and two virtual processors. Reliable startup and avoiding host sleep are important for continuous bulb control.
Four Linkind A19 RGBTW bulbs use Matter over Wi-Fi on 2.4 GHz. The PC may use 5 GHz if both radios reach the same local network; these bulbs do not require a Thread border router.
Samsung Health data reaches Home Assistant through Health Connect and companion sensors. Check measurement freshness; sleep records cannot be assumed present until the source actually supplies them.
The second PC is no longer needed for Raya testing. Stop using the remote SSH testing workflow and run acceptance on the primary PC.
Use a faster local model for ordinary conversation and a stronger coding model for implementation and review. Heavy jobs queue and unload models so conversation retains resource headroom.
Raya supports jobs, routines, goals and project work as well as voice conversation. Worker activity should show task, progress, model and a working cancellation control.
Archived original sleep plan: all four bulbs, including ceiling, gradually fade from 21:00 to 22:30. Superseded by the current ceiling-off-at-start policy.
Archived proposal: wake lighting is a manually selected bright scene. Superseded by the current one-hour sunrise schedule.
Archived early preference: af_heart was liked before selecting Onyx and later expressive Chatterbox narration.
Future proposal only: continuously log daily events automatically once reviewed policies and permission controls are ready. Not enabled.
Simulated TEST amber and red temperature alerts were sent successfully without intentionally heating the hardware.
An experimental four-second Eden marketing clip was requested. This request did not establish successful video inference.
An idle hardware screenshot showed GPU 34 Celsius and system temperature 37 Celsius; these historical readings are not current telemetry.
A browser worker may search sources and extract a colour palette. Browser execution and memory embeddings are different services.
Backups preserve Home Assistant configuration, local service manifests and SecondBrain notes. Restoration requires clear instructions and verified saved archives.
The Home Assistant credential is held in secure storage. The lighting adapter limits allowed devices and modes; credential text must not appear in notes.
Conversation summaries and retrieved memories leave room for current tasks. An embedding model does not enlarge the generation model context limit.
Cloud workers and their reserved tasks were released. Do not assign new work to cancelled cloud workers.

def atomic(self, path, raw):
        safe(path)
        stage = path.with_name(path.name + '.' + uuid.uuid4().hex + '.tmp')
        with stage.open('xb') as file:
            file.write(raw)
            file.flush()
            os.fsync(file.fileno())
        os.replace(stage, path)
